rank_devices: four distinct NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB devices, as bound in input_binding.json
observed_failure: All eight step-1 rows still produced nonfinite gradients after the v1 address-conditioner stabilization, so training stopped before any optimizer update.

gradient_diagnostic.affected_scope: All 41 earlier attention layers and three earlier sparse FFN taps were nonfinite; the final attention layer and final FFN tap remained finite.
gradient_diagnostic.branch_attribution: The correct-state branch was already nonfinite before donor-state and layer-permuted-state contrast branches ran. The contrast branches were not the origin.

root_cause: The MoE fusion evaluated sqrt(mean(global_recurrent_reads^2)) at an exact zero recurrent read. Clamping only after sqrt preserved the finite forward identity but could not prevent the singular sqrt derivative from contaminating backward.
authorized_numerical_change: Evaluate recurrent, projected-carrier, and global-recurrent RMS as sqrt(mean(x^2) + 1e-12), then explicitly return exact zero for exact-zero inputs. Do not change model capacity, architecture, gains, trainable families, training schedule, or the locked endpoint.

post_fix_diagnostic.diagnostic_stop: The diagnostic deliberately required nine accepted rows from an eight-row global batch, forcing a stop before optimizer update 1 and before endpoint access.
